settings.title: Basic email on your own domain.

settings.editor: Simple mailboxes (IMAP and POP3) for businesses that just need email to work. One flat price for the whole team, no per-mailbox fees, and the same SpamExperts filtering the bigger plans get.

icon_list.text: 20GB of fast storage (SSD), shared across the team
Secure webmail, plus setup on Android and Apple devices

settings.editor: Or $90 a year. All prices exclude GST.

Basic email runs on a hosting account (cPanel). If you host your website with us on a cPanel plan, your email sits alongside it. If you only need email and no website, we'll set up a small hosting account to run it, just ask and we'll sort it.

settings._title: Card – Basic email is right if

settings.editor: You mostly send and receive email, you want one flat price for the team, and you don't need shared calendars or the Office apps. It just works, on any device.
Your team shares calendars and contacts, you want bigger mailboxes, or you use Word, Excel and Teams. Priced per mailbox, so you only pay for who needs it.

tabs.tab_title: What's the difference between IMAP and POP3?
tabs.tab_content:
IMAP keeps your email on the server, so your inbox, folders and read messages stay in sync on every device. POP3 downloads email to one device and usually removes it from the server.

For most teams IMAP is the better choice. Both are included.

tabs.tab_title: Is 20 email accounts a hard limit?
tabs.tab_content: The plan includes 20 email accounts on your domain. If your team needs more, give us a call on 08 6365 4522 and we'll find the right setup.

tabs.tab_title: Does my website hosting plan already include email?
tabs.tab_content: Basic email runs on a hosting account (cPanel). If you host your website with us on a cPanel plan, your email sits alongside it.

tabs.tab_title: Can you move my existing mailboxes across?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Send us a Hosting Transfer Request and our Perth team will plan the move with you.

tabs.tab_title: Will it work with Outlook, Apple Mail and my phone?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. IMAP and POP3 work with Outlook, Apple Mail and the mail apps on Android and Apple devices, and there's secure webmail too.
